effective_at_verification_note: The BIST regular-session closing-auction local time could not be verified from an official Borsa Istanbul source in the implementing environment: direct fetches of borsaistanbul.com/en/markets/equity-market/trading-hours and a specialized market-hours data provider both returned HTTP 403 (bot-protection, not a proxy/network failure) when attempted 2026-07-17, and a general web search returned only secondary-source aggregation, not a primary-source citation. This policy therefore never guesses or hardcodes a local close time or defaults to midnight/retrieval time -- effective_at remains a mandatory, explicit --effective-at CLI argument on every promotion run until a verified convention is authored here. This is a recorded known limitation, not a silent omission.
